 Follow How Sir Ian McKellen and Star Trek cast members are remembering Sir Patrick Stewart
 Chris Pugh Sun, November 1, 2026 at 11:00 AM UTC 1 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. An outpouring of emotional tributes from Hollywood co-stars, entertainment studios, and millions of fans flooded social media following the announcement of Sir Patrick Stewart's passing at age 86.
 The primary focal point across global news feeds was an official statement released by Stewart's family, describing his final moments as filled with love, music, tears, and laughter, according to reporting by NJ.com . The family expressed gratitude for his lifelong devotion and grace.
 Longtime close friend and co-star Sir Ian McKellen led celebrity tributes, with fans widely sharing photos celebrating their iconic, decades-long friendship across stage and screen, as noted by the BBC . Meanwhile, "Star Trek" colleagues including Jonathan Frakes and William Shatner honored Stewart by sharing famous catchphrases like "Make it so" to honor Captain Jean-Luc Picard, per Deadline .
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Major entertainment studios also joined the worldwide remembrance. Marvel Studios released a public statement honoring Stewart's two-decade portrayal of Professor Charles Xavier in the "X-Men" franchise, calling him a generous collaborator and true gentleman whose talent shaped modern cinema.
